confusions.titleZh: a / an：看聲音，不只看字母
confusions.conceptZh: 兩者都放在單數可數名詞前。下一個字以母音聲音開始用 an，其他用 a。
rules: 注意 hour 的 h 不發音，因此是 an hour

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and I have an eraser, too.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it is a new one.

confusions.titleZh: am / is / are：主詞決定 be 動詞
confusions.conceptZh: I 配 am；he、she、it 和單數配 is；you、we、they 和複數配 are。情態動詞或 to 後使用 be。

examples.text: The dog is under the desk.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we are in the same class.

confusions.conceptZh: I、you、we、they 用 do；he、she、it 用 does。用了 does，後面的動詞回原形。
rules: Does she like，不說 Does she likes

confusions.titleZh: I / you / he / she / it / we / they
confusions.conceptZh: 代名詞替代人物或物品。I 永遠大寫；it 通常代替單一物品或動物；we 包含說話者。

checks.prompt: Tom is my friend. ___ is nice.
The book is new. ___ is red.

confusions.titleZh: this / that / these / those：距離與單複數
confusions.conceptZh: 近處單數 this、遠處單數 that；近處複數 these、遠處複數 those。
in 表示在裡面或較大時間；on 表示接觸表面或日期；at 表示一個點或精確時間。

examples.text: The pencil is in the box.
The book is on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is on Friday at nine.

confusions.titleZh: under / in front of / next to
confusions.conceptZh: under 是正下方；in front of 是前方；next to 是緊鄰旁邊。

examples.text: The cat is under the chair.
The bus is in front of the school.
The bank is next to the bookstore.
My shoes are under the bed.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is in front of the bank.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is the bank next to the store?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, they are side by side.

checks.prompt: The pencil is below the book.
The two stores are side by side.

confusions.conceptZh: here 是靠近說話者；there 是離說話者較遠的位置。

examples.text: The bus stop is over there.
There is a bird in that tree.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it is here on my desk.

confusions.conceptZh: come 是朝說話者或目的地靠近；go 是離開目前位置前往別處。

examples.text: I go to school by bus.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you come to my house?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I can go after lunch.

confusions.conceptZh: say 重點是說出的內容；speak 常接語言或正式發言；talk 表示交談，常用 talk to/with/about。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you talk about at school?

confusions.conceptZh: house 是建築物；room 是房子裡的一個房間；home 強調居住與歸屬，可直接說 go home。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I live in a small house.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but I study at home in the living room.

checks.prompt: The kitchen is a ___ in a house.

confusions.conceptZh: job 是一份職業或工作；work 可指工作這件事或動詞；worker 是做工作的人。

examples.text: My father has a new job.
My parents work in the city.
We have a lot of work today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: He is a worker at a bakery.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: He works from Monday to Friday.

confusions.conceptZh: child 是正式的單數；children 是不規則複數；kid 是較口語的孩子。

examples.text: The child is five years old.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, he is the youngest child in my family.

confusions.conceptZh: morning 是起床到中午前；afternoon 是中午後；evening 是傍晚到睡前。

examples.text: I eat breakfast in the morning.
We have art in the afternoon.
I eat dinner in the evening.
The sky gets dark in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you do in the evening?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I eat dinner with my family.

confusions.conceptZh: today 是今天；yesterday 是昨天；tomorrow 是明天；ago 從現在往前數一段時間。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, I saw her two days ago.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, she will come after lunch.

confusions.conceptZh: and 加上相同方向資訊；but 表示轉折；or 提供選擇；so 表示前因後果。

examples.text: I have a pen and a ruler.
The bag is old, but it is clean.
Do you want tea or water?
I was tired, so I went home.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you want rice or bread?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The soup is hot, but it is good.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I am hungry, so I can eat it.

checks.prompt: The dog is small, ___ it is strong.

confusions.conceptZh: 肯定句常用 some；一般問句與否定句常用 any。邀請或預期答案是 yes 的問句也可用 some。

examples.text: We do not have any milk.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, there are some on the table.

confusions.conceptZh: big/small 說整體大小；tall 說由下到上的高度；long/short 說長度，short 也可說身高較矮。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, and it is very tall.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but its hair is short.

confusions.conceptZh: hot 是很熱；warm 是舒適的溫暖；cool 是稍冷或涼爽。

checks.prompt: Tea that is comfortable to drink is ___.

confusions.conceptZh: good 是一般的好；fine 常回答身體狀況沒問題；nice 表示令人愉快或待人友善；great 比 good 更強。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It was great, and the people were nice.

confusions.conceptZh: breakfast 是早上第一餐；lunch 是中午餐；dinner 通常是晚餐或一天的主餐。

examples.text: Dinner is in the dining room.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you eat for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I eat bread and an egg.

confusions.conceptZh: phone 是最常用總稱；telephone 可指電話或較正式說法；cellphone 特別指行動電話。

examples.text: I call Mom on the phone.
My cellphone is in my bag.
The office telephone is on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, my cellphone is on the table.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you know the school's telephone number?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is on this card.

confusions.conceptZh: TV 是 television 的縮寫；movie 是電影；news 是新聞，形式看似複數但通常當不可數名詞。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: The evening news is on now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can we watch a movie later?

confusions.conceptZh: 作為季節時兩者都表示秋天；fall 較常見於美式英文，autumn 英美皆可用。fall 也可作動詞「掉落」。

examples.text: We go hiking in the fall.
Do not fall on the wet road.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, fall and autumn can name the same season.

checks.prompt: another word for the season fall

confusions.conceptZh: sport 可指一種運動；sports 指運動活動的總稱；swimming 與 soccer 是具體運動名稱。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you play sports at school?

confusions.conceptZh: cookie 是單數，cookies 是複數。cooky 是較少見的舊拼法，學習時以 cookie 為主。

examples.text: There are three cookies on the plate.
The old spelling cooky is uncommon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, may I have two cookies?
